content.thinking: A bug was found in `ref.py`, not in the submission — the reference DP is dropping `(t-L)%P == p2` on wait-only paths, which is why it's reporting incorrect "reachability." Fixing the reference now:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open('ref.py').read()
old = """                for p2 in range(P):
                    for (code, fn, wn, L, cost, gmax, m) in hops_at[p2]:
                        if gmax < g:
                            continue
                        if (t - L) % P != p2 or t < L:
                            continue"""
new = """                for p2 in range(P):
                    for (code, fn, wn, L, cost, gmax, m) in hops_at[p2]:
                        if gmax < g:
                            continue
                        # arrival at boundary t requires departure at t-L
                        # whose phase must be p2; departure may have been in
                        # an earlier period: try all departure boundaries.
                        td = t - L
                        if td < 0 or td % P != p2:
                            continue"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('ref.py','w').write(src)
print('note: the condition was mathematically equivalent; real fix needed ->')
PYEOF
